title: Journal Of Anatomy V 1.0
author: Vedek Bheemaiah
description:
A Journal of Anatomy is an inner exploration of two women, who live in a spiritual universe, far separated from the mainstream, where men are saints and women lesbians. the story explores the life over two years to a blissful wedding, with philosophical spicing.
The next version would include more active material, with a deeper philosophical innuendo.
